node.label: Anti-proteinase 3 antibody positivity
node.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the blood circulation that react against proteinase 3. Proteinase 3 (PR3) antigen is a 29-kD serine protease that exists as a protein triplet in human neutrophils

evidence.snippet: Eosinophilic granulomatosis with polyangiitis: Anti-proteinase 3 antibody positivity (frequency HP:0040282) [TAS]
